title: Louise de la Vallière
author: Alexandre Dumas · Auguste Maquet
description: "Louise de la Vallière" by Alexandre Dumas and Auguste Maquet is a historical novel likely written in the mid-19th century, as part of the larger series known as the D'Artagnan Romances.
longDescription: The story follows the adventures and intrigues surrounding D’Artagnan and his friends, delving into their lives intertwined with the French court, particularly focusing on themes of love, betrayal, and power.

authorInfo.bio: Alexandre Dumas, also known as Alexandre Dumas père, was a French novelist and playwright.
